sentences.text:
Hanumangarh (Presently Lodged In Dist. Jail Hanumangarh)
 ----Appellant
Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through PP 2.

Smt. S Devi W/o Sh. Jagdish S/o Brij Lal, Ward No. 58  Sureshia Hanumangarh Jn, Ps Hanumangarh Jn Dist.
 Hanumangarh  ----Respondents For Appellant(s) : Mr. R.S. Gill.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, PP.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 21/07/2023 Heard learned counsel representing the appellant and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

This appeal has been preferred on behalf of the appellant under Section 14A(2) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Amendment Act 2015 being aggrieved by the order dated 19.04.2023 passed by learned Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocity) Cases, Hanumangarh in Cr. Misc.
Case No.58/2023 (48/2023) rejecting the bail application preferred on behalf of the appellant who is in custody in connection with FIR No.411/2022, Police Station Mahila, Hanumangarh, for the offences under (2 of 3) [CRLAS-569/2023] Sections 450, 376(2)(N) and 506 IPC and Sections 3(1)(S) and 3(2)(V) of the SC/ST Act.

entities.text: Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocity) Cases, Hanumangarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that appellant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel submitted that the allegation against the appellant is that he subjected the prosecutrix to sexual assault/rape for about 2 months by threatening to make her obscene photographs and videos viral.

Learned counsel submitted that investigating agency during the course of investigation into the matter, has not recovered any obscene photographs or videos as Kale Khan vs State Of Rajasthan on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165382688/
1 alleged by the prosecutrix.

entities.text: Kale Khan vs State Of Rajasthan on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix is a mature married woman aged about 30 years and has roped the petitioner in a false criminal case without furnishing any just explanation for the delay occasioned in filing of the present FIR.
Learned counsel submitted that challan has already been filed; the appellant is in custody and the trial of the case is likely to consume sufficiently long time.
On these grounds, he implored the Court to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Consequently, the appeal is allowed.

The order dated 19.04.2023 passed by learned Special Judge,
SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocity) Cases, Hanumangarh is set aside.

It is ordered that (3 of 3)
[CRLAS-569/2023] the accused-appellant Kale Khan S/o Sh. Munsif Ali arrested in connection with FIR No.411/2022, Police Station Mahila, Hanumangarh shall be released on bail during pendency of the trial; provided he furnishes personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two surety bonds of Rs.25,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 353-Tikam/-
